children: Faraday Future launched nine new EAI device configurations and four industry solutions; Master Mini starts at $9,990 and all products are available for sale and delivery.
Introduced nine new EAI device configurations across five models including All-New Futurist, Master Mini and FX Aegis series; available for sale and delivery.
Priced key products: Master Mini series starts at $9,990; All-New Futurist Standard $89,900, Ultra $129,900; Aegis Mega from $74,990; Aegis Hyper from $137,900.
Launched four Industry Productivity Solutions for K-12 Education, Research, Security and Inspection to lower deployment barriers and boost ROI.
Completed FF EAI Robot World Version 2.0 with expanded portfolio covering humanoid, quadruped and mobile manipulator forms (11 models, 24 products).
Established a “6+1” direct sales and RoboShare rental network; customers can order via FF.com, Amazon and RobotShop.
